models.name: Mercury 2
models._source: https://www.inceptionlabs.ai/blog/introducing-mercury-2 — Diffusion-based reasoning model with parallel (non-autoregressive) token generation. 1009 tok/s on NVIDIA Blackwell. Pricing $0.25 input / $0.75 output per 1M. OpenAI API compatible. Tunable reasoning, native tool use, schema-aligned JSON.

benchmarks.name: MemRouter (LoCoMo F1)
benchmarks.description: Memory-as-Embedding Routing for Long-Term Conversational Agents (arxiv 2605.00356, submitted 2026-05-01). Decouples memory admission from answer generation via lightweight 12M-param classification heads. Evaluated on LoCoMo conversational QA. Reports F1 + memory-management latency (p50).
